title: Hotel Controls
intro: Guest-room control from the door plate to the bedside: key-card power, scene panels, service requests and curtain control. Reference prices are per unit and move with protocol, finish and order quantity.
price_note: Reference price per unit, EXW. Hotel projects are usually quoted per room set — send the room count and the panel schedule for a project price.
